      About this item

      • 【7 Programmable Mouse Buttons】 Great wave off kanagawa wired gaming mouse, designed for computer games. 7 customizable programmable mouse buttons, allow you assign custom commands to the buttons according to your specific needs.
      • 【5 Adjustable DPI & 4 Polling Rate】This pc gaming mouse adopt advanced optical sensor, adjustable DPI (200-12000) and polling rate (125-1000Hz) that provide precise cursor movement, ensure quick and accuracy gaming experience.
      • 【Ergonmic Game Mouse】 Ergonomic design, fitting naturally in your hand and reducing wrist pain even using a long time. Extra non-slip grips on both side help aim and make strafing so much easier. 20million times keystroke test ensures the gaming mouse for a lasting use lifecycle.
      • 【Customizable RGB Backlit Gaming Mouse】 12 RGB lighting modes and support customize lighting from nearly 16.8 million colors via software to meet your individual needs. RGB breathing light is much more vibrant than basic light up mouse, and you can turn off lights when unwanted.
      • 【Widely Compatibility】 Plug and play wired computer gaming mouse, compatible with most system and devices, such as WindowsMac OS/Linux/Chrome OS/Desktop/Laptop. ( Note: the programmable functions are not workable for Mac system. )

      How customer reviews and ratings work

      Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

      To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.
